'''Magic Bait''' is a type of [[bait]] that provides the ability to catch any fish from that source regardless of weather, time, or season. Magic Bait has the same effect on fish bite rate as standard [[Bait (item)|Bait]] (decreasing biting time by 50%).<ref name="fishbitetime" />

Magic Bait cannot be used with the [[Training Rod]] or the [[Bamboo Pole]]. Only the [[Fiberglass Rod]], the [[Iridium Rod]], and the [[Advanced Iridium Rod]] can use bait. It can also technically be inserted into a [[Crab Pot]], but it is no better than [[Bait (item)|standard bait]] as all crab pot fish can be caught regardless of weather or season.

20 Magic Bait can be purchased from the shop in [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for {{Price|5|gem}}. The recipe to craft Magic Bait can also be purchased for {{Price|20|gem}}.

==Use==
{{#lst:Bait|baituse}}

==Fish Locations==
[[File:NightMarketMagicBaitArea.png|thumb|right|120px|Area for Night Market fish]]
See [[Fishing Strategy#Location Tables|the fish location tables]] for a list of all fish that can be caught in a specific area. As long as the fish can be caught at some point in a specific area, it can be caught anytime by using Magic Bait. [[Fish#Night Market Fish|Night Market Fish]] can be caught anytime using Magic Bait in the southwest corner of [[The Beach]]. [[Fish#Legendary Fish|Legendary Fish]] can be caught anytime in their specific locations by using Magic Bait.
